      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &

      call halt_program

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &

      call halt_program

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')

      call halt_program

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

      call halt_program

      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)

#else

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine space_distribute_block_vector(xy,sl,a,b,toall)
      use xmpi_module
      use general_mpi_module
      implicit none
      character, intent(in)               :: xy
      type (spacepars), intent(in)        :: sl
      real*8, dimension(:,:), intent(in)  :: a
      real*8, dimension(:,:), intent(out) :: b

      !    integer                             :: i
      include 'space_distribute.inc'
logical, optional, intent(in)       :: toall

character, intent(in)               :: xy
      type (spacepars), intent(in)        :: sl
      real*8, dimension(:,:), intent(in)  :: a
      real*8, dimension(:,:), intent(out) :: b

      !    integer                             :: i
      include 'space_distribute.inc'
logical, optional, intent(in)       :: toall

select case(xy)
       case('y')
         call vector_distr(a,b,sl%js,sl%ln,src,comm)
       case default
         print *,'error in space_distribute_block_vector, other than "y" not tested'

      character(*)    :: filename

      call halt_program

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine space_distribute_vector(xy,sl,a,b,toall)
      use xmpi_module
      use general_mpi_module
      implicit none
      ! Not sure what this xy  is doing here.
      ! Ok, the master process holds a vector of length ny+1 or nx+1
      ! This vector will be distributed among all processes.
      ! if xy .eq. 'x', the distribution is done according
      ! to the values in is and lm, i.e. the global vector
      ! has a size equal to the size of the first dimension of the
      ! global area: nx+1.
      ! In the other case, the distribution is done according to
      ! the values in js and ln, i.e. the global vector has a size
      ! equal to the second dimension of the global area: ny+1
      !
      character, intent(in)                     :: xy
      type (spacepars), intent(inout), target   :: sl
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(in)          :: a
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(out)         :: b

      integer, dimension(:), pointer    :: ijs,lmn
      include 'space_distribute.inc'
logical, optional, intent(in)       :: toall

character, intent(in)                     :: xy
      type (spacepars), intent(inout), target   :: sl
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(in)          :: a
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(out)         :: b

      integer, dimension(:), pointer    :: ijs,lmn
      include 'space_distribute.inc'
logical, optional, intent(in)       :: toall

if(xy .eq.'x') then
         ijs => sl%is
         lmn => sl%lm
      else
         ijs => sl%js
         lmn => sl%ln
      endif
      call vector_distr(a,b,ijs,lmn,src,comm)

   end subroutine space_distribute_vector

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine space_distribute_vector(xy,sl,a,b,toall)
      use xmpi_module
      use general_mpi_module
      implicit none
      ! Not sure what this xy  is doing here.
      ! Ok, the master process holds a vector of length ny+1 or nx+1
      ! This vector will be distributed among all processes.
      ! if xy .eq. 'x', the distribution is done according
      ! to the values in is and lm, i.e. the global vector
      ! has a size equal to the size of the first dimension of the
      ! global area: nx+1.
      ! In the other case, the distribution is done according to
      ! the values in js and ln, i.e. the global vector has a size
      ! equal to the second dimension of the global area: ny+1
      !
      character, intent(in)                     :: xy
      type (spacepars), intent(inout), target   :: sl
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(in)          :: a
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(out)         :: b

      integer, dimension(:), pointer    :: ijs,lmn
      include 'space_distribute.inc'
logical, optional, intent(in)       :: toall

character, intent(in)                     :: xy
      type (spacepars), intent(inout), target   :: sl
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(in)          :: a
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(out)         :: b

      integer, dimension(:), pointer    :: ijs,lmn
      include 'space_distribute.inc'
logical, optional, intent(in)       :: toall

if(xy .eq.'x') then
         ijs => sl%is
         lmn => sl%lm
      else
         ijs => sl%js
         lmn => sl%ln
      endif
      call vector_distr(a,b,ijs,lmn,src,comm)

   end subroutine space_distribute_vector

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine space_distribute_vector(xy,sl,a,b,toall)
      use xmpi_module
      use general_mpi_module
      implicit none
      ! Not sure what this xy  is doing here.
      ! Ok, the master process holds a vector of length ny+1 or nx+1
      ! This vector will be distributed among all processes.
      ! if xy .eq. 'x', the distribution is done according
      ! to the values in is and lm, i.e. the global vector
      ! has a size equal to the size of the first dimension of the
      ! global area: nx+1.
      ! In the other case, the distribution is done according to
      ! the values in js and ln, i.e. the global vector has a size
      ! equal to the second dimension of the global area: ny+1
      !
      character, intent(in)                     :: xy
      type (spacepars), intent(inout), target   :: sl
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(in)          :: a
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(out)         :: b

      integer, dimension(:), pointer    :: ijs,lmn
      include 'space_distribute.inc'
logical, optional, intent(in)       :: toall

character, intent(in)                     :: xy
      type (spacepars), intent(inout), target   :: sl
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(in)          :: a
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(out)         :: b

      integer, dimension(:), pointer    :: ijs,lmn
      include 'space_distribute.inc'
logical, optional, intent(in)       :: toall

if(xy .eq.'x') then
         ijs => sl%is
         lmn => sl%lm
      else
         ijs => sl%js
         lmn => sl%ln
      endif
      call vector_distr(a,b,ijs,lmn,src,comm)

   end subroutine space_distribute_vector

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine space_distribute_vector(xy,sl,a,b,toall)
      use xmpi_module
      use general_mpi_module
      implicit none
      ! Not sure what this xy  is doing here.
      ! Ok, the master process holds a vector of length ny+1 or nx+1
      ! This vector will be distributed among all processes.
      ! if xy .eq. 'x', the distribution is done according
      ! to the values in is and lm, i.e. the global vector
      ! has a size equal to the size of the first dimension of the
      ! global area: nx+1.
      ! In the other case, the distribution is done according to
      ! the values in js and ln, i.e. the global vector has a size
      ! equal to the second dimension of the global area: ny+1
      !
      character, intent(in)                     :: xy
      type (spacepars), intent(inout), target   :: sl
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(in)          :: a
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(out)         :: b

      integer, dimension(:), pointer    :: ijs,lmn
      include 'space_distribute.inc'
logical, optional, intent(in)       :: toall

character, intent(in)                     :: xy
      type (spacepars), intent(inout), target   :: sl
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(in)          :: a
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(out)         :: b

      integer, dimension(:), pointer    :: ijs,lmn
      include 'space_distribute.inc'
logical, optional, intent(in)       :: toall

if(xy .eq.'x') then
         ijs => sl%is
         lmn => sl%lm
      else
         ijs => sl%js
         lmn => sl%ln
      endif
      call vector_distr(a,b,ijs,lmn,src,comm)

   end subroutine space_distribute_vector

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine space_distribute_vector(xy,sl,a,b,toall)
      use xmpi_module
      use general_mpi_module
      implicit none
      ! Not sure what this xy  is doing here.
      ! Ok, the master process holds a vector of length ny+1 or nx+1
      ! This vector will be distributed among all processes.
      ! if xy .eq. 'x', the distribution is done according
      ! to the values in is and lm, i.e. the global vector
      ! has a size equal to the size of the first dimension of the
      ! global area: nx+1.
      ! In the other case, the distribution is done according to
      ! the values in js and ln, i.e. the global vector has a size
      ! equal to the second dimension of the global area: ny+1
      !
      character, intent(in)                     :: xy
      type (spacepars), intent(inout), target   :: sl
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(in)          :: a
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(out)         :: b

      integer, dimension(:), pointer    :: ijs,lmn
      include 'space_distribute.inc'
logical, optional, intent(in)       :: toall

character, intent(in)                     :: xy
      type (spacepars), intent(inout), target   :: sl
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(in)          :: a
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(out)         :: b

      integer, dimension(:), pointer    :: ijs,lmn
      include 'space_distribute.inc'
logical, optional, intent(in)       :: toall

if(xy .eq.'x') then
         ijs => sl%is
         lmn => sl%lm
      else
         ijs => sl%js
         lmn => sl%ln
      endif
      call vector_distr(a,b,ijs,lmn,src,comm)

   end subroutine space_distribute_vector

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine space_distribute_vector(xy,sl,a,b,toall)
      use xmpi_module
      use general_mpi_module
      implicit none
      ! Not sure what this xy  is doing here.
      ! Ok, the master process holds a vector of length ny+1 or nx+1
      ! This vector will be distributed among all processes.
      ! if xy .eq. 'x', the distribution is done according
      ! to the values in is and lm, i.e. the global vector
      ! has a size equal to the size of the first dimension of the
      ! global area: nx+1.
      ! In the other case, the distribution is done according to
      ! the values in js and ln, i.e. the global vector has a size
      ! equal to the second dimension of the global area: ny+1
      !
      character, intent(in)                     :: xy
      type (spacepars), intent(inout), target   :: sl
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(in)          :: a
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(out)         :: b

      integer, dimension(:), pointer    :: ijs,lmn
      include 'space_distribute.inc'
logical, optional, intent(in)       :: toall

character, intent(in)                     :: xy
      type (spacepars), intent(inout), target   :: sl
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(in)          :: a
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(out)         :: b

      integer, dimension(:), pointer    :: ijs,lmn
      include 'space_distribute.inc'
logical, optional, intent(in)       :: toall

if(xy .eq.'x') then
         ijs => sl%is
         lmn => sl%lm
      else
         ijs => sl%js
         lmn => sl%ln
      endif
      call vector_distr(a,b,ijs,lmn,src,comm)

   end subroutine space_distribute_vector

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine space_distribute_vector(xy,sl,a,b,toall)
      use xmpi_module
      use general_mpi_module
      implicit none
      ! Not sure what this xy  is doing here.
      ! Ok, the master process holds a vector of length ny+1 or nx+1
      ! This vector will be distributed among all processes.
      ! if xy .eq. 'x', the distribution is done according
      ! to the values in is and lm, i.e. the global vector
      ! has a size equal to the size of the first dimension of the
      ! global area: nx+1.
      ! In the other case, the distribution is done according to
      ! the values in js and ln, i.e. the global vector has a size
      ! equal to the second dimension of the global area: ny+1
      !
      character, intent(in)                     :: xy
      type (spacepars), intent(inout), target   :: sl
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(in)          :: a
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(out)         :: b

      integer, dimension(:), pointer    :: ijs,lmn
      include 'space_distribute.inc'
logical, optional, intent(in)       :: toall

character, intent(in)                     :: xy
      type (spacepars), intent(inout), target   :: sl
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(in)          :: a
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(out)         :: b

      integer, dimension(:), pointer    :: ijs,lmn
      include 'space_distribute.inc'
logical, optional, intent(in)       :: toall

if(xy .eq.'x') then
         ijs => sl%is
         lmn => sl%lm
      else
         ijs => sl%js
         lmn => sl%ln
      endif
      call vector_distr(a,b,ijs,lmn,src,comm)

   end subroutine space_distribute_vector

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine space_distribute_vector(xy,sl,a,b,toall)
      use xmpi_module
      use general_mpi_module
      implicit none
      ! Not sure what this xy  is doing here.
      ! Ok, the master process holds a vector of length ny+1 or nx+1
      ! This vector will be distributed among all processes.
      ! if xy .eq. 'x', the distribution is done according
      ! to the values in is and lm, i.e. the global vector
      ! has a size equal to the size of the first dimension of the
      ! global area: nx+1.
      ! In the other case, the distribution is done according to
      ! the values in js and ln, i.e. the global vector has a size
      ! equal to the second dimension of the global area: ny+1
      !
      character, intent(in)                     :: xy
      type (spacepars), intent(inout), target   :: sl
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(in)          :: a
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(out)         :: b

      integer, dimension(:), pointer    :: ijs,lmn
      include 'space_distribute.inc'
logical, optional, intent(in)       :: toall

character, intent(in)                     :: xy
      type (spacepars), intent(inout), target   :: sl
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(in)          :: a
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(out)         :: b

      integer, dimension(:), pointer    :: ijs,lmn
      include 'space_distribute.inc'
logical, optional, intent(in)       :: toall

if(xy .eq.'x') then
         ijs => sl%is
         lmn => sl%lm
      else
         ijs => sl%js
         lmn => sl%ln
      endif
      call vector_distr(a,b,ijs,lmn,src,comm)

   end subroutine space_distribute_vector

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine space_distribute_vector(xy,sl,a,b,toall)
      use xmpi_module
      use general_mpi_module
      implicit none
      ! Not sure what this xy  is doing here.
      ! Ok, the master process holds a vector of length ny+1 or nx+1
      ! This vector will be distributed among all processes.
      ! if xy .eq. 'x', the distribution is done according
      ! to the values in is and lm, i.e. the global vector
      ! has a size equal to the size of the first dimension of the
      ! global area: nx+1.
      ! In the other case, the distribution is done according to
      ! the values in js and ln, i.e. the global vector has a size
      ! equal to the second dimension of the global area: ny+1
      !
      character, intent(in)                     :: xy
      type (spacepars), intent(inout), target   :: sl
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(in)          :: a
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(out)         :: b

      integer, dimension(:), pointer    :: ijs,lmn
      include 'space_distribute.inc'
logical, optional, intent(in)       :: toall

character, intent(in)                     :: xy
      type (spacepars), intent(inout), target   :: sl
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(in)          :: a
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(out)         :: b

      integer, dimension(:), pointer    :: ijs,lmn
      include 'space_distribute.inc'
logical, optional, intent(in)       :: toall

if(xy .eq.'x') then
         ijs => sl%is
         lmn => sl%lm
      else
         ijs => sl%js
         lmn => sl%ln
      endif
      call vector_distr(a,b,ijs,lmn,src,comm)

   end subroutine space_distribute_vector

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine space_distribute_vector(xy,sl,a,b,toall)
      use xmpi_module
      use general_mpi_module
      implicit none
      ! Not sure what this xy  is doing here.
      ! Ok, the master process holds a vector of length ny+1 or nx+1
      ! This vector will be distributed among all processes.
      ! if xy .eq. 'x', the distribution is done according
      ! to the values in is and lm, i.e. the global vector
      ! has a size equal to the size of the first dimension of the
      ! global area: nx+1.
      ! In the other case, the distribution is done according to
      ! the values in js and ln, i.e. the global vector has a size
      ! equal to the second dimension of the global area: ny+1
      !
      character, intent(in)                     :: xy
      type (spacepars), intent(inout), target   :: sl
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(in)          :: a
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(out)         :: b

      integer, dimension(:), pointer    :: ijs,lmn
      include 'space_distribute.inc'
logical, optional, intent(in)       :: toall

character, intent(in)                     :: xy
      type (spacepars), intent(inout), target   :: sl
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(in)          :: a
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(out)         :: b

      integer, dimension(:), pointer    :: ijs,lmn
      include 'space_distribute.inc'
logical, optional, intent(in)       :: toall

if(xy .eq.'x') then
         ijs => sl%is
         lmn => sl%lm
      else
         ijs => sl%js
         lmn => sl%ln
      endif
      call vector_distr(a,b,ijs,lmn,src,comm)

   end subroutine space_distribute_vector

      character(*)    :: filename

      call halt_program

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine space_distribute_vector(xy,sl,a,b,toall)
      use xmpi_module
      use general_mpi_module
      implicit none
      ! Not sure what this xy  is doing here.
      ! Ok, the master process holds a vector of length ny+1 or nx+1
      ! This vector will be distributed among all processes.
      ! if xy .eq. 'x', the distribution is done according
      ! to the values in is and lm, i.e. the global vector
      ! has a size equal to the size of the first dimension of the
      ! global area: nx+1.
      ! In the other case, the distribution is done according to
      ! the values in js and ln, i.e. the global vector has a size
      ! equal to the second dimension of the global area: ny+1
      !
      character, intent(in)                     :: xy
      type (spacepars), intent(inout), target   :: sl
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(in)          :: a
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(out)         :: b

      integer, dimension(:), pointer    :: ijs,lmn
      include 'space_distribute.inc'
logical, optional, intent(in)       :: toall

character, intent(in)                     :: xy
      type (spacepars), intent(inout), target   :: sl
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(in)          :: a
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(out)         :: b

      integer, dimension(:), pointer    :: ijs,lmn
      include 'space_distribute.inc'
logical, optional, intent(in)       :: toall

if(xy .eq.'x') then

      call vector_distr(a,b,ijs,lmn,src,comm)

subroutine report_file_read_error(filename)

      use xmpi_module,    only: halt_program
      implicit none

      character(*)    :: filename

      call writelog('lswe','','Error reading file ''',trim(filename),'''')
      call writelog('lswe','','Check file for incorrect decimal format,', &
      ' doubles instead of integers, line breaks and tab characters')
      call halt_program
   end subroutine report_file_read_error

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine space_distribute_vector(xy,sl,a,b,toall)
      use xmpi_module
      use general_mpi_module
      implicit none
      ! Not sure what this xy  is doing here.
      ! Ok, the master process holds a vector of length ny+1 or nx+1
      ! This vector will be distributed among all processes.
      ! if xy .eq. 'x', the distribution is done according
      ! to the values in is and lm, i.e. the global vector
      ! has a size equal to the size of the first dimension of the
      ! global area: nx+1.
      ! In the other case, the distribution is done according to
      ! the values in js and ln, i.e. the global vector has a size
      ! equal to the second dimension of the global area: ny+1
      !
      character, intent(in)                     :: xy
      type (spacepars), intent(inout), target   :: sl
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(in)          :: a
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(out)         :: b

      integer, dimension(:), pointer    :: ijs,lmn
      include 'space_distribute.inc'
logical, optional, intent(in)       :: toall

character, intent(in)                     :: xy
      type (spacepars), intent(inout), target   :: sl
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(in)          :: a
      real*8, dimension(:), intent(out)         :: b

      integer, dimension(:), pointer    :: ijs,lmn
      include 'space_distribute.inc'
logical, optional, intent(in)       :: toall

if(xy .eq.'x') then

         lmn => sl%lm
      else

      endif
